name: aggrega
description: Runs Aggrega as a Model Context Protocol server, so an assistant can compile and inspect a Release and read catalog entities through a structured protocol instead of scraping command output. This package carries no Aggrega program of its own: it launches the aggrega executable already installed on this machine — the aggrega command found on this application's PATH, unless you choose another executable below.

binary_path.title: Path to the aggrega executable
binary_path.description: The aggrega executable this package launches, rather than carrying one of its own. Left at aggrega, it is the aggrega command found on the PATH this application was started with; a PATH changed since then reaches it once the application is quit and started again. Choose a file here to run an aggrega that is not on that PATH, or a different one than it finds first. If no aggrega is installed, install it first: https://aggrega.ai/docs/install/

workspace_root.title: Workspace folder
workspace_root.description: Select the folder of the Aggrega workspace the assistant works in — the folder that holds your project's .aggrega-config.yaml. Every request that names no folder of its own is answered in this workspace; while this setting is empty, the server answers each such request that acts in the workspace with a refusal asking you to set it.
